body: Thanks. Please report suspected vulnerabilities privately as described in https://prometheus.io/docs/operating/security/ rather than in a public issue.

message: SECURITY decision: The issue reports vulnerabilities in Prometheus itself. Precheck: not maintainer-authored, strong vulnerability signals, no missing template sections, no other project mentions. Duplicate search: similar issues found but not clear duplicates (different versions or already addressed). Label validation: SECURITY decision requires no labels. Emitted a comment per policy.
